The Arima Kinen, where contenders earn the 
right to enter based on fan votes.

Having earned the fans' votes through her 
success in the Classic races, Mejiro Ryan 
proudly secured her spot.

A fierce race featuring Senior-class 
Umamusume, including Oguri Cap, who was 
hailed as a "Monster."

Mejiro Ryan headed to the race, fearful of 
the Umamusume with fathomless potential 
who awaited her.
